artifact_verification.config_and_tokenizer: content-hashed around preflight and full weight loading
artifact_verification.scope: requires immutable local snapshots; not cryptographic proof against concurrent tampering
artifact_verification.weights: content-hashed once before loading; path/inode/size/mtime/ctime checked before and after loading

expert_backend_evidence.performance_claim_limit: do not attribute timings to grouped_mm kernels without a separate runtime trace
expert_backend_evidence.scope: HF expert configuration only; no runtime kernel execution verified

model.revision_status: operator-declared; actual local artifact bytes independently hashed

projection_scope: per-document samples include native parity and backward; do not extrapolate as measured suite cost
